Very useful when exploring snow-covered mountains.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Drinking Spicy Elixirs will grant [[Link]] one level of [[Cold Resistance]] by warming his body to the core. They're useful in cold environments and snow-covered mountains, such as [[Mount Lanayru]], the [[Hebra Mountains]], and the [[Gerudo Highlands]]. Spicy Elixirs can be made by [[Cooking]] any of the following critters with [[Monster Part]]s in a [[Cooking Pot]]: * [[Summerwing Butterfly]] * [[Warm Darner]] By adding any of these spicy ingredients, Link can make a Spicy Elixir that will also heal him: * [[Spicy Pepper]] * [[Sunshroom]] * [[Warm Safflina]] * [[Sizzlefin Trout]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Elixir }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Elixirs, Food, Health Restoring Items |items= BotW, TotK }}
